hero.headline: Turning business data into better project and financial decisions.
hero.description: I combine project performance analytics, revenue forecasting and financial scenario modeling to support informed business decisions.

about.summary: I hold a master’s degree in Business Analytics from Arizona State University and a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from NIIT University. My experience spans IT project governance, hospitality revenue management, real estate cost estimation and business intelligence. I use data, reporting automation and cross-functional collaboration to improve operational and financial performance.
